## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend offline unit tests pass.
- [ ] Frontend test, typecheck, lint, and build pass.
- [ ] `npm audit` and `git diff --check` pass.
- [ ] New real-model checks are opt-in and do not affect the normal suite.

## Privacy and Data

- [ ] No private recording, transcript, database, credential, or model weight is committed.
- [ ] New network calls, persisted fields, migrations, and model/license changes are documented.
- [ ] Existing databases remain upgradeable without deletion.

## UI

- [ ] Desktop and mobile behavior were checked.
- [ ] Controls have accessible names, keyboard behavior, focus, errors, and loading states.
